comment: Role definitions for prompt packs (D42-D44). The variable set is a contract: a prompt may only use these names, and `required` ones must survive into the composed text. Both the worker (lusora_contracts) and the platform (lib/prompts.ts) read this file — no mirrored list to drift.

research.description: Topic -> a documentary research brief the SCRIPT agent writes from (D64). Produces research.md; never produces narration. Its output is prose for another agent to read, so it is checked for shape (the welded section list) rather than parsed.

target_seconds.source: style_pack.script.target_seconds (D45) — brief to the depth the script will actually use

script.description: Narration writer. Output is spoken verbatim by TTS and quoted verbatim by the planner.

research.source: research.md, when the pipeline runs a research stage (D64) — absent renders the block away, so a pipeline without research composes byte-identically

planner.description: Script + style pack + catalog -> beat sheet JSON. Output is schema- and validator-checked, then repaired up to 3 times.

component_menu.source: catalog, filtered by the style pack's allowed_packs

coverage_scope.source: derived: 'the ENTIRE script' for a single call, or a section-scoped phrase when the script is split into chunks

full_script.source: the whole script.txt, for context only; set only when this call is one of several chunks

carry_forward.source: the previous chunk's last beats (id/mood/visual_intent), for continuity across a chunk boundary

chunk_position.source: e.g. 'part 2 of 5'; set only when this call is one of several chunks

max_overlays.source: derived: this chunk's slack-free share of the whole-video overlay density budget; set only when chunked

spine.source: the spine pass's arc + section summaries, with THIS section marked; set only when chunked

visual_ledger.source: visual subjects already used by earlier sections, so the video does not shoot the same image twice; set only when chunked

emphasis_per_minute.source: style_pack.overlays.emphasis.per_minute, and only when that class is enabled (D59) — empty otherwise, which is what keeps the prompt byte-identical for a pack that does not use it

spine.description: Phase 1 of the beat planner on a long script: the whole script -> section boundaries + a one-line summary each + the arc. Emits INDICES into a sentence list the code numbered, never script text, so its output is checked by arithmetic and a bad spine degrades to the deterministic word-balanced split instead of failing a video.

script.source: script.txt, one numbered sentence per line

sentence_count.source: how many numbered sentences the script has

chat.description: Editor request -> proposed beat ops + plan ops. Never applies anything (D15).
